clips.title: The story
paras: At the Venture Company site southwest of Sludge Fen, the Control Console Operating Manual guides workers through the machinery. It explains how to close the valves and disengage the samophlange.

Southwest of Sludge Fen, the Venture Company runs a drilling and research site in the northern Barrens. Its machinery links gauges, pressurized valves, and mechanisms to a device called a samophlange. Without the right instructions, working the volatile controls can cause a dangerous failure or lock the system. The manual gives the valve sequence for disengaging the core apparatus without triggering an explosive failure.
